description: This file is a shell script that performs tests related to the 'git p4' integration, specifically focusing on error handling scenarios. It sets up a Perforce server, adds files, and tests authentication errors and ticket management.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that must fail for the test to pass.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with a given message.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
